title: Proactive refresh with a skewed client clock: lastRefreshed guard only covers this tab's own token -> refresh ping-pong between tabs (one refresh per request) and one refresh per 30 s in a single tab, while every Bearer sent was still valid server-side
evidence: vitest (client clock = server+20min, server issues 15-min tokens): 4 requests -> 3 POST /api/v1/auth/refresh, refreshRatio 0.75; the 2nd refresh fires immediately after another tab writes a rotated pair to localStorage. No 401 was ever returned by the API. With 2 tabs polling queue status every 1-3 s this exceeds RateAuth (1/s, burst 10, per IP) -> refresh 429 -> apiFetch rejects with ApiError HTTP_429 from the proactive path (line 122 throw await toApiError(res)) and the original request is never sent. Spec §5: 'clock skew (do not decide expiry client-side beyond a hint)'.
fix: Do not decide expiry from the client clock alone: estimate skew from the issued token (iat vs Date.now() at receipt, or a Date response header) and only refresh early when (exp - skew - now) <= 30 s; alternatively drop proactive refresh entirely and rely on the reactive 401 path, or make the guard token-independent (any refresh in the last N seconds seen via storage timestamp, e.g. persist `ef_refreshed_at` so all tabs share it).

title: 401 that is not refreshable (no session -> /problems/unauthorized; or retried request still /problems/token-expired) is mapped to UNKNOWN 'Lỗi hệ thống khi giữ vé (HTTP 401)' instead of AUTH_REQUIRED; same in payment-client (line 250: 'Lỗi thanh toán HTTP 401')
evidence: vitest: requestHold with no session and fetch -> 401 /problems/unauthorized => HoldClientError.type 'UNKNOWN', message 'Lỗi hệ thống khi giữ vé (HTTP 401)'. requestHold with refresh OK but retry still 401 token-expired => 'UNKNOWN' 'HTTP 401'. initiatePayment with 401 => PaymentClientError 'UNKNOWN' 'Lỗi thanh toán HTTP 401'. The HoldClientErrorType/PaymentClientErrorType union already has AUTH_REQUIRED but only the thrown ApiError path uses it.
fix: In requestHold/cancelHold/initiatePayment/getOrderDetails/issueTickets map `response.status === 401 && !QUEUE_TOKEN_PROBLEMS.has(type)` to AUTH_REQUIRED (and 403 /problems/forbidden to a distinct code) so the UI shows the sign-in alert.

title: CheckoutView renders nothing for a hold error of type UNKNOWN (401 when logged out / logged out in another tab, HTTP 500): the button just returns to idle with no message
evidence: vitest: render CheckoutView (ON_SALE event, queue token present) with fetch -> 401 /problems/unauthorized, click 'Giữ vé và thanh toán' => no new role=alert, no text matching /401|đăng nhập|Lỗi hệ thống/, button back to idle and clickable. Same with 500. CheckoutView only renders alerts for NOT_ADMITTED, QUEUE_TOKEN_INVALID, AUTH_REQUIRED, PER_IDENTITY_LIMIT, QUANTITY_NOT_ALLOWED; (checkout)/layout.tsx has no auth guard so a logged-out user can reach the page. Partially pre-existing (develop also had no generic branch) but the 401 path is new with the Bearer switch.
fix: Add a fallback `<Alert variant="error">{error.message}</Alert>` for any error type not handled explicitly (UNKNOWN/LIMIT_EXCEEDED/AMBIGUOUS message), and together with X-2 show the sign-in alert for 401.

title: register/verify 201 followed by a failed auto-login (e.g. 429 from the auth rate class after request-otp + verify + login from one IP, or 5xx) rejects with the LOGIN error; RegisterForm.handleVerifyOTP (line 367) rethrows it as 'OTP không hợp lệ' and stays on the OTP step although the account now exists -> re-submitting the OTP yields 409, user is stuck
evidence: vitest: verify -> 201, login -> 429 => verifyRegistrationOTP rejects with ApiError status 429, getSession() null, no marker that registration succeeded; a second verify call -> 409 conflict. RegisterForm.tsx:364-368 catches any error and throws `err?.detail || 'OTP không hợp lệ'`, never advancing to SUCCESS nor pointing to sign-in.
repro:
it('register then login 429',async()=>{setupEnv();const {calls}=installFetch((c)=>{if(c.path==='/api/v1/auth/register/verify')return json({id:'u-1',role:'buyer',created_at:'x'},201);if(c.path==='/api/v1/auth/login')return problem(429,'/problems/rate-limited','qua nhieu request');return problem(500,'x');});const err=await rejection(verifyRegistrationOTP('a@b.c','password1','123456'));expect(err.status).toBe(429);expect(getSession()).toBeNull();expect(calls.map(c=>c.path)).toEqual(['/api/v1/auth/register/verify','/api/v1/auth/login']);});
it('second verify',async()=>{setupEnv();installFetch((c)=>c.path==='/api/v1/auth/register/verify'?problem(409,'/problems/conflict','identifier da ton tai'):problem(500,'x'));const err=await rejection(verifyRegistrationOTP('a@b.c','password1','123456'));expect(err.status).toBe(409);});
fix: Make verifyRegistrationOTP return `{registered:true, session:null, loginError}` (or throw an ApiError with code REGISTERED_LOGIN_FAILED) when verify succeeded but login failed; RegisterForm then shows SUCCESS with a 'Đăng nhập' link instead of an OTP error.

title: 409 idempotency-in-progress (+ Retry-After: 1) is mapped to AMBIGUOUS with no retry, and the Idempotency-Key is regenerated on every requestHold call (line 116), so no retry (reload, second click after reset) is ever idempotent — spec §5 'idempotent retry after 409 in-flight (Retry-After)' is not implemented
evidence: vitest: fetch -> 409 {type:'urn:eventflow:problem:idempotency-in-progress'} with Retry-After:1 => HoldClientError AMBIGUOUS after exactly 1 request (Retry-After ignored). Two consecutive requestHold calls for the same event/tier/qty carry two different Idempotency-Key headers. use-hold-timer.ts never passes idempotencyKey. Pre-existing on develop (key was also per call), but the §5 edge case is listed for this change.
fix: Persist the key per (eventId, ticketTypeId, quantity) in sessionStorage (like issueKeyFor) and reuse it until a 2xx/4xx terminal answer; on 409 in-progress wait Retry-After (default 1 s, bounded attempts) and re-send the SAME key instead of surfacing AMBIGUOUS.

title: Payment retry after a NETWORK_ERROR (request may have reached the server) sends POST /payments again with a NEW Idempotency-Key -> BR-O5 not honoured, two payment initiations possible for one order
evidence: vitest renderHook(usePaymentSession): submitPayment #1 -> fetch throws TypeError => error 'Không thể kết nối...'; submitPayment #2 -> 200. Two POST /v1/events/e1/payments with different Idempotency-Key headers. payment-client.ts:188 defaults the key per call; the hook never passes one. Pre-existing on develop; still violates the BR-O5 comment in the same file.
repro: it('new key on retry',async()=>{setupEnv();seedSession();let n=0;const {calls}=installFetch(()=>{n++;if(n===1)throw new TypeError('Failed to fetch');return json({payment_id:'p2',order_id:'o1',redirect_url:'/x',status:'PENDING'});});const {result}=renderHook(()=>usePaymentSession({eventId:'e1',orderId:'o1',holdId:'h1',amount:100}));act(()=>result.current.setFormData({buyerName:'A',buyerEmail:'a@b.c',buyerPhone:'0912345678',method:'sandbox'}));await act(async()=>{await result.current.submitPayment();});await act(async()=>{await result.current.submitPayment();});const p=calls.filter(c=>c.path==='/v1/events/e1/payments');expect(p).toHaveLength(2);expect(p[0].headers.get('Idempotency-Key')).not.toBe(p[1].headers.get('Idempotency-Key'));});
fix: Generate the key once per (orderId, holdId) in the hook (useRef / sessionStorage `ef:pay:{orderId}`) and pass it to initiatePayment on every retry; rotate only after a definitive 4xx.

title: Edit mode: the slug input is enabled and pre-filled, but updateOrganizerEvent drops `slug` (PUT contract has no slug) and resolves without error -> silent field loss
evidence: vitest: render EventWizard with initialEvent -> #event-slug disabled=false, value 'rock-fest'. updateOrganizerEvent(id,{slug:'new-slug',title:'Rock Fest'}) -> PUT body has no 'slug' property, returned event.slug still 'rock-fest', no error/warning.
repro:
it('slug enabled',()=>{render(<EventWizard initialEvent={organizerEvent('DRAFT')} onSubmit={vi.fn()}/>);const s=screen.getByLabelText(/Slug/i);expect(s.disabled).toBe(false);});
it('slug dropped',async()=>{setupEnv();seedSession('acc','r','organizer');const {calls}=installFetch(()=>json(wire('DRAFT')));const res=await updateOrganizerEvent(EVT,{slug:'new-slug',title:'Rock Fest'});expect(calls.find(c=>c.method==='PUT').body).not.toHaveProperty('slug');expect(res.slug).toBe('rock-fest');});
fix: Disable the slug input when `isEditing` (read-only hint 'không thể đổi sau khi tạo'), or throw in updateOrganizerEvent when input.slug differs from existing.slug.

title: ON_SALE events are blocked from the whole edit page, so the AC-22 path 'existing tiers only allow quota changes via PUT .../tiers/{tierId}; on ON_SALE a quota decrease is blocked client-side' has no UI entry point — a quota INCREASE while ON_SALE (allowed by backend, BR-E3) is impossible; the wizard's isCurrentOnSale/BR-E3 branch (event-wizard.tsx:200-215) is dead code
evidence: vitest: EditEventClient with getOrganizerEventById -> state ON_SALE renders 'Không thể chỉnh sửa sự kiện' and no 'Số lượng vé' input. updateTierQuota (organizer-service.ts:474) implements the ON_SALE rule but nothing calls it for ON_SALE.
repro:
vi.mock('@/lib/organizer-service',async(o)=>({...(await o()),getOrganizerEventById:mocks.getById}));vi.mock('@/hooks/use-auth',()=>({useAuth:()=>({user:{id:'u-1',role:'organizer'},loading:false,isAuthenticated:true,hasRole:(r)=>r.includes('organizer')})}));vi.mock('next/navigation',()=>({useRouter:()=>({push:vi.fn()})}));
it('on sale blocked',async()=>{mocks.getById.mockResolvedValue({...ev,state:'ON_SALE',tiers:[{id:'t1',name:'VIP',price:100,quota:10}]});render(<EditEventClient eventId={EVT}/>);expect(await screen.findByText(/Không thể chỉnh sửa sự kiện/)).toBeInTheDocument();expect(screen.queryByLabelText(/Số lượng vé/)).toBeNull();});
fix: For ON_SALE (and other non-editable states that still allow tier ops) render a tiers-only mode: fields of step 1/3 read-only, PUT /events skipped, only addTier/updateTierQuota calls; keep the full block only for COMPLETED/CANCELLED.

title: joinQueue -> 401 token-expired -> refresh rejected -> session cleared, but the waiting room shows 'Đã xảy ra lỗi mạng ... thử lại' (ApiError is not a QueueError) and no sign-in link
evidence: vitest: fetch join -> 401 /problems/token-expired, refresh -> 401 => role=alert text contains 'lỗi mạng', no link named 'đăng nhập', localStorage ef_token null (user was logged out).
repro:
vi.mock('next/navigation',()=>({useRouter:()=>({push:vi.fn()})}));vi.mock('@/hooks/use-server-time-sync',()=>({useServerTimeSync:()=>({offsetMs:0,synced:true,isLoading:false,error:null,getServerNow:()=>Date.now()})}));vi.mock('@/components/assistant/chat-panel',()=>({ChatPanel:()=>null}));
it('auth required = network error',async()=>{setupEnv();seedSession('old','r1');installFetch((c)=>c.path==='/api/v1/auth/refresh'?problem(401,'/problems/unauthorized'):c.path.endsWith('/queue/join')?problem(401,'/problems/token-expired'):json({}));await act(async()=>{render(<WaitingRoom eventId='e1'/>);});await act(async()=>{await Promise.resolve();});const a=await screen.findByRole('alert');expect(a.textContent).toContain('lỗi mạng');expect(screen.queryByRole('link',{name:/đăng nhập/i})).toBeNull();expect(localStorage.getItem('ef_token')).toBeNull();});
fix: In initQueueToken's catch, check `err instanceof ApiError && err.code === 'AUTH_REQUIRED'` and show the sign-in action (same as kind 'device'/'otp').

title: Web Locks path has no timeout/ifAvailable/steal: if another tab holds 'ef-auth-refresh' and is suspended (bfcache/throttled), every authenticated apiFetch in this tab hangs forever
evidence: vitest: navigator.locks.request stubbed to never resolve; apiFetch on a 401 token-expired stays pending after 10 min of fake time.
fix: Pass an AbortSignal with a timeout (e.g. 10 s) to locks.request and fall back to doRefresh without the lock when it aborts; or use `steal: true` after a timeout.

title: Proactive refresh that fails on the network rejects the whole request with NETWORK_ERROR even though the current access token (<=30 s left, or skewed clock) may still be accepted by the server; the original request is never attempted
evidence: vitest: token with 20 s left, refresh fetch throws TypeError -> apiFetch rejects NETWORK_ERROR, 0 calls to /v1/orders/o1.
repro: it('early refresh network',async()=>{setupEnv();vi.useFakeTimers();const S=1_800_000_000;vi.setSystemTime(S*1000);const {calls}=installFetch((c)=>{if(c.path==='/api/v1/auth/refresh')throw new TypeError('Failed to fetch');return json({ok:true});});seedSession(jwt(S+20),'r1');const err=await rejection(apiFetch('/v1/orders/o1'));expect(err.code).toBe('NETWORK_ERROR');expect(calls.filter(c=>c.path==='/v1/orders/o1')).toHaveLength(0);});
fix: Catch NETWORK_ERROR from the proactive refresh and fall through to sending the request with the current token (the reactive 401 path still covers true expiry).

title: Corrupted ef_user JSON makes getSession() null while ef_refresh is still a valid server-side token; logout() then skips POST /logout, so the refresh token is wiped locally but never revoked
evidence: vitest: ef_user='{not json', ef_refresh='ref-valid-on-server' -> logout() makes 0 calls to /api/v1/auth/logout; ef_refresh removed from storage.
fix: logout() should read ef_refresh directly from both storages (not via getSession) before clearing; or session.readFrom should keep returning the tokens with a placeholder user when only ef_user is corrupt.

title: setSession wipes both storages BEFORE writing; if setItem throws mid-write (quota / private mode) neither the old nor the new session survives -> silent logout right after a successful login/refresh
evidence: vitest: Storage.prototype.setItem throws on the 2nd call -> after setSession(a2) getSession() is null (a1 was wiped first).
fix: Write the three keys first (try/catch), and only wipe the OTHER store / old values after a successful write; on failure restore the previous values.

title: readFrom only checks typeof role === 'string'; an unknown role (e.g. 'admin', or a tampered value) is returned as Role and reaches RoleGuard/useAuth
fix: Validate role against the Role union (buyer|organizer|moderator|ops) and return null (treat as logged out) otherwise.

title: Google login: when /devices succeeds and /refresh fails on the NETWORK (response lost after the server rotated the pair) the client restores the original Google refresh token, which may already be revoked -> the next token-expired turns into a forced logout
evidence: vitest: google 200, devices 200, refresh throws TypeError -> getSession().refreshToken === 'g-ref' (the possibly-consumed token). Per contract the Google session is kept, but the restored token is not necessarily valid.
repro: it('google refresh lost',async()=>{setupEnv();installFetch((c)=>{if(c.path==='/api/v1/auth/google')return json({id:'u-1',role:'buyer',access_token:'g-acc',refresh_token:'g-ref'});if(c.path==='/api/v1/auth/devices')return json({device_id:'d1'});if(c.path==='/api/v1/auth/refresh')throw new TypeError('Failed to fetch');return problem(500,'x');});await loginWithGoogle('cred');expect(getSession()?.refreshToken).toBe('g-ref');});
fix: Only restore googleSession when the failure came from /devices or from a refresh that returned a definitive 4xx; on a refresh NETWORK_ERROR keep whatever is in storage and let the next request retry the refresh.

title: Step-3 gate applies BR-E2 (sale start >= now+30 min) to EVERY path, so 'Lưu nháp' (and editing a DRAFT/SCHEDULED/REJECTED event whose sale start is <30 min away or in the past) can never reach step 4, while createOrganizerEvent only enforces BR-E2 when submitForReview
evidence: vitest: wizard with sale start = now+5 min -> 'Tiếp tục' on step 3 shows 'hiện cách 5 phút', no 'Lưu nháp' button reachable; createOrganizerEvent({...saleStartAt: now+5min, submitForReview:false}) resolves without failedStep.
repro: it('draft blocked',()=>{vi.useFakeTimers();vi.setSystemTime(new Date('2026-10-21T10:00:00+07:00'));render(<EventWizard onSubmit={vi.fn()}/>);fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Tên sự kiện/),{target:{value:'T'}});fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Địa điểm/),{target:{value:'V'}});fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button',{name:/Tiếp tục/}));fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button',{name:/Tiếp tục/}));const d=new Date(Date.now()+5*60000);const pad=(n)=>String(n).padStart(2,'0');fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(/Thời gian bắt đầu mở bán/),{target:{value:`${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth()+1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}T${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}`}});fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button',{name:/Tiếp tục/}));expect(screen.getByText(/hiện cách 5 phút/)).toBeInTheDocument();expect(screen.queryByRole('button',{name:/Lưu nháp/})).toBeNull();vi.useRealTimers();});
fix: Move the BR-E2 check from handleNext(step 3) into handleSubmit(submitForReview === true) only; show it as a warning on step 3.
